help: the check suite over src/ and rsc/ - code and schema, the same on any clone; the corpus is the data gate's (corpus-yoga pipeline run) (also what the pre-commit hook runs); SENDS one request to github to check the pinned MCP schema, which YOGA_NO_SEND=1 refuses without failing the run

args.name: --fix
args.help: run every fix command, then stop — stages nothing (review and stage yourself)

args.name: --fresh
args.help: ignore the section cache: re-run every check (the cache stat-hashes each section's declared subject; unchanged sections replay)

urllib.request.urlopen: one GET of the pinned MCP schema's upstream URL, to check it is current; YOGA_NO_SEND=1 skips it without failing the run (may_send)
